name: adaptive-fee
author: DNA
summary: Raises the project fee with realized volatility; capped by the constitution.
killConditions: any ModuleFailed from this plate while it is the canary
in-window swaps charged at the canary ceiling > 30% (≥ 10 in-window swaps); ceiling = the plate's cap, or the active fee + 1 point when the hook's canary clamp binds first

in-window swap rate < 70% of the out-of-window rate over the last 1 h or the last full canary window, whichever is longer (≥ 10 out-of-window swaps, a full window of in-window blocks, and ≥ 10 in-window swaps expected at the out-of-window rate)
